description: This file implements a login page component for a web dashboard, handling two-step authentication flow: first collecting email and fetching associated organizations, then prompting for organization selection and password for login. It manages state, UI styling, and interaction with backend API functions.

methods.name: handleFetchOrgs
methods.description: Handles form submission to fetch user organizations based on the entered email.

methods.name: handleLogin
methods.description: Handles form submission to perform login with provided credentials and organization info.
